title: OSG202 - SP26 - FE - Đề 1 (50 câu)
description: 50 câu từ OSG202_SP26_FE; đã sửa câu 16, 26, 40; ghi chú cảnh báo trực tiếp trên các câu có vấn đề. Các câu chưa chắc chắn giữ đáp án gốc và ghi rõ.

questions.q: When designing a paging system, which of the following factors is the most critical in minimizing translation overhead?
options: Increasing the number of page table entries per process.
Using a Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) for faster lookups.
Storing page tables in slower secondary storage.
Assigning fixed-size page frames without considering process needs.

questions.q: In UNIX systems, what is the primary purpose of system calls like fork() and exec()?
options: To load device drivers into memory.
To create and execute new processes.
To switch between user and kernel mode.

questions.q: In threads, web servers use this fact to improve performance by maintaining a collection of heavily used pages in main memory to eliminate the need to go to disk to get them. What is a collection called?
In C-SCAN scheduling, what happens when arm reaches end?

⚠️ CÂU DỄ NHẦM: 'fixed-sized partitions' có thể chỉ phân vùng cố định (Contiguous Allocation, B), nhưng Paging (A) cũng dùng các khung trang cố định. Tạm giữ B.

Which memory management technique involves dividing memory into fixed-sized partitions to accommodate varying process sizes?
questions.explain: Giữ B theo cách hiểu fixed partitioning thuộc contiguous allocation; câu hỏi chưa đủ rõ.

questions.q: Which statement is true about implementing Threads in Kernel?
options: The kernel has a thread table
The threads run on top of a runtime system
Suitable for OS that does not support threads

questions.q: If FIFO page replacement algorithm is used with four page frames, how many page faults will occur with the reference string 0172327103 if the four frames are initially empty?

⚠️ CÂU THIẾU ĐIỀU KIỆN: Circular wait là điều kiện cần; chỉ đủ để kết luận deadlock trong một số mô hình tài nguyên (ví dụ mỗi loại có một instance). Tạm giữ B theo ý đề.

Which condition is both necessary and sufficient for a system to experience deadlock?
questions.explain: Không nên học thuộc rằng circular wait luôn là điều kiện cần và đủ.

options: SSDs store data without needing contiguous blocks

questions.q: Which approach to deadlock prevention eliminates circular wait?
options: Forcing all processes to request resources in a predefined order
Allowing processes to hold and wait for resources indefinitely
Preventing mutual exclusion for critical resources
Granting all resources to a process before execution begins

options: The process switches from running to a ready state.

The process switches from running to a suspended state.

questions.q:
A system has 10 units of a single resource. There are three processes: P1, P2, and P3. At a certain moment, their maximum needed and allocated units are:
Process   Maximum Needed   Allocated
P1        6                3
P2        5                4
P3        7                3
What is the state of the system?
options: The system is in a deadlock.

Evaluate the impact of the absence of real segmentation support in the 64-bit version of the x86 architecture on modern operating systems, considering memory management efficiency and design choices.
options: The absence of real segmentation results in more efficient memory utilization but limits the diversity of memory management techniques in modern systems.
Real segmentation support significantly improves memory management performance, especially in handling dynamic data structures.
The lack of real segmentation simplifies memory management but limits the flexibility to handle changing memory requirements in modern operating systems.
The absence of real segmentation has no impact on modern operating systems as they rely solely on paging techniques for memory management.
questions.explain: Không khẳng định segmentation hoàn toàn biến mất khỏi x86-64.
